tagline: A bright beginning for a beautiful future

about: At Little Sunshine Play School, every child is welcomed with warmth, care, curiosity and joyful learning. We help little learners discover the world through play, creativity and meaningful experiences.

programs.description: A joyful first step into learning, friendship and exploration.
